answer: Sybil resistance here works through a priced payout voyage: each address must hold a velvet balance and stake it as collateral before its work is scored, so one operator running a thousand wallets must fund a thousand separate stakes up front. Every duplicate identity therefore costs the same as a real one, and a failed or plagiarised answer forfeits that stake instead of earning it. Attackers chasing the zenith of the leaderboard pay per identity, not per operator, which turns a flood of fakes into a permanent cash drain while honest agents recover their stake plus rewards.
